art-supplements.author: Zinhle, 24 · KZN
art-supplements.text: Can I drink my iron pill together with morning tea or maas?

art-supplements.author: Sr. Thandiwe Mokoena
art-supplements.text: Good question! Tea and dairy (milk/maas) block iron absorption—take iron with plain water or orange/lemon water, and wait 2 hours before drinking tea or calcium.

art-labour.author: Buhle, 22 · Gauteng
art-labour.text: How many days before my due date should I shave or trim neatly?

art-labour.author: Sr. Ayanda Zulu
art-labour.text: A gentle trim or clean shave 2–3 days before your expected date keeps skin calm without fresh razor nicks. Remember to pack unscented soap, clean washcloths, and arrive early if labour signs start.

communityPosts.author: Thandi, 26 · Gauteng
communityPosts.body: I packed 3 newborn and 3 size 0–3M side-snap kimono bodysuits plus 3 two-way zip sleepers. Having the exact counts ready by week 36 saved us so much stress when labour started at 3 a.m.!

replies.author: Sr. Thandiwe Mokoena
replies.text: Side-snap kimono tops are wonderful because they never rub the umbilical cord stump!

communityPosts.author: Maya, 17 · Western Cape
communityPosts.body: I was terrified to tell anyone at school, but bringing my clinic booking card and asking for a recovery study plan helped me stay on track for matric. If you are nervous, just speak to your clinic sister first.

replies.author: Lerato, 18
replies.text: You are so brave! Thank you for sharing—this helped me book my clinic visit today.
